spectre.description: Deployment orchestrator for containerized services. Spawn as a subagent for deploy, rollback, status, list, dashboard, schedule, and secrets operations across environments. Use for pre_check → build → deploy → health_check → record pipeline, docker-compose/kubernetes/SSH targets, rolling/blue_green/canary strategies, deployment locks, web dashboard, scheduled cron deployments, .env secrets, multi-service and parallel deploys, and CI/CD integration. Also orchestrates development tasks across the broader Modelink ecosystem including Microsoft Foundry model deployment, fine-tuning, capacity discovery, and agent management.
